messages.en: I'm a regular here. I've been eating here for years.
No wonder the owner knows you! Let's just eat there, then.

senses.en_definition: Each; every individual member of a group, without exception.
Every; at each occurrence of a specified time or interval.

messages.en: I have breakfast here every day. Want to join me tomorrow?
I'd love to! What time do you usually get here? I have to be at work by eight.
Seven. You'll have time—this place is close to your office.
Let's invite at least two more people so we'll have enough for a team.
Sure, I'll ask Hafiz and Lina now.

senses.en_definition: To agree; to share an opinion or give one's approval.
Aligned in direction, intention, or purpose.
Compatible, suitable, or consistent with something.

messages.en: Dinner at our usual place at eight tonight. Sound good?
Works for me. Just don't be late like last time 😂
Haha, I'll get there before you this time. Just you wait.
